design_set: The 96-query SEM-D0 cohort is design-exposed and may only be used for taxonomy and rule design
fresh_population: Previously unused canonical train queries, excluding every SEM-A0/B0/B1/C0/D0 query
candidate_contract: One or two exact source spans in source order, joined by ' ; ', final evidence <=16 Qwen3-8B tokens
verifier_contract: Parse the question into an answer type, required predicate(s), known argument(s), and explicit constraints
Verify every required predicate and argument from the serialized exact-source candidate alone
Do not resolve a truncated name, pronoun, title, or relation using text outside the serialized candidate
ABSTAIN for unknown schemas, missing arguments, missing constraints, ambiguous coreference, or unsupported conjunctions
The verifier may reject or abstain but may not generate or repair evidence
notes: The Wilson bound prevents a nominal 95% result on a tiny emitted sample from being treated as reliable.
Candidate-generation coverage and relation-closure precision are reported separately.
No Teacher or Target calls are permitted before this gate passes.
Human IAA is unavailable; any AI-assisted annotation must be reported as such.
